pages.text: The garden is warm and gold. Dot the ladybug climbs to the very top of a leaf.
The bumblebee drops into a flower, buzzing slower and slower. Goodnight, little friend.
The garden spider finishes her web, sits in the middle and folds her legs. She is gentle, and very proud of her web.
The snail slides home under the mint leaves, carrying his house on his back.
The ants march in a line back into their hill, the very last one carrying a crumb.
The caterpillar curls up on a cabbage leaf, full and sleepy.
The dragonfly lands on the pond reed and rests her four wings.
The grasshopper does one last hop, then sits still in the grass.
The butterfly folds her wings under a rose petal.
The earthworm wriggles down into the cool soft soil. Goodnight, little friend.
Dew drops settle on the web, on the leaves, on Dot.
Dot tucks her wings under her shell and sleeps on her leaf. Goodnight, little garden.
